integrity: Exact-rational exhaustive finite verification for 24 size/parameter instances supports the finite formula; the all-n and asymptotic claims are proved analytically. Review is not independent, and no external audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite distribution assumes a one-way directed cycle, independent direct-voting indicators and independent caster correctness. The Gaussian competence frontier has fixed direct-voting rate between zero and one and local deviations of order \(n^{-1/2}\); it does not decide finite-n inequalities on the equality frontier. The primary full text of a 2026 related expected-voting-weight study was not accessible; equivalent unindexed statements remain possible.
title: Exact ballot dispersion and the competence frontier for clockwise delegation on a cycle
